comments.mergedPostDetails:
Currently to search through my VRC group of 200+ I have to press 'List More Members' and ctrl-f to find the member. 

I think it would be best to have a search filter, so you can find a specific group member. I can see this being a bigger and bigger problem the larger your group gets.
comments.value:
This please. My group has over a thousand members, and I got so frustrated searching for users that I needed to add roles to that I made an API tool to apply the role for me on specific users. 

Not everyone has the know how or time to do something like that.

I'm guessing that this sort of thing will be part of wave two or three of updates. But if not PLEASE let us search.

I am one of the admins and the murder drones group and we have 10,000 members and when I need to ban someone, I can't and I have to look for hours and half the time only 2000 people show up on the list. So we can't recruit new admins because none of them pop up so please make this a feature it would be the best!
